event.description:
Entry Fee: $50 plus tax.

Register Here: https://magicstronghold.com/store/category/Grand%20Archive%20Events
RSVPing for this event on Omnidex does not guarantee entry. Please purchase a ticket on the Magic Stronghold website to secure your seat.

Tournament Format:
- Standard Constructed
- Up to 7 Swiss rounds NO TOP CUT
- (Decklists are required, proxies are disallowed aside from cards in the Proxia's Vault.)

Prizes:
Participation:
- 1 entry gift (GA themed Dragon Shield Sleeves)
- 2 Radiant Origins booster packs
- 1 Radiant Origins sapphire pack

Top 16:
- 1x RDO North America Invite Card
- Finalist Playmat

1st place:
- Champion Playmat

*Additional prizing will be announced day-of based on player turnout.
event.name: Magic Stronghold - Radiant Origins Regional
